paper.title_en: Diagrammatic Monte Carlo for Fermionic Rényi Entanglement Entropy
paper.abstract_en: We develop a direct diagrammatic Monte Carlo method for the second Rényi entropy of inter- acting lattice fermions. Fermionic replica sewing yields a connected-determinant (CDet) expansion, which we sample with many-configuration Markov-chain Monte Carlo. On a 3 \times 3 Hubbard clus- ter, deterministic coefficients through third order agree with exact-diagonalization derivatives for three reference shifts, while sampling extends the series to tenth order. For a reference shift with a continuous stability region, conformal-Borel resummation also gives good agreement with the exact entropy. We further compute coefficients through ninth order on 40 \times 40 and 50 \times 50 periodic lat- tices, with subsystems of up to 676 sites. The resummed results from different reference shifts show good agreement at a common truncation order. Their shift and order dependence provide checks on the stability of the continuation. These calculations extend connected-diagram sampling to spatial Rényi observables on large finite fermionic systems.
